rights: Sources are private visual references. No permission for redistribution of the photographs is recorded. Model geometry is newly authored.
address_separation: The listing gives 80 Yuqing Road as former residence and present office.
The Gao article describes No. 3 of the compound as previously part of Tianping Road Lane 75. Do not infer that every neighbouring building has the twin winter gardens.

Xinmin 2021-10-12 attributes a three-storey Spanish red-tile house to the address; its two article illustrations actually display the 146 Lane Aitang Xincun signage. No architectural dimension or red-tiled roof from that account enters the paired-garden front.

Principal building construction year remains undetermined by an independently confirmed primary record. The 1932 date in the Spanish-style account is not assigned to the photographed Modernist flat roof.
survey: 2013 Gao photograph dimensions 4912x3231 after slight vertical crop vs 4912x3264 EXIF. Use 1080x711 coordinates in this bundle. The opposite 934x700 view is unscaled. Winter garden centres and outer radii come from the separately documented 2021/2025 aerial roof-arc measurements. Bare or occluded details are unwarranted on other buildings within the site.
